import json, math, struct, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).parent
old=root.parent.parent/'llmx-attention-long'
out=root/'long'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
p=subprocess.run([str(root/'candidate-long.exe'),str(root.parent.parent/'Qwen3-0.6B-F32.gguf'),str(root.parent.parent/'llmx-f32-controls/prompt.txt'),str(out/'llmx')],capture_output=True,timeout=180)
(out/'generated.txt').write_bytes(p.stdout)
(out/'stderr.txt').write_bytes(p.stderr)
p.check_returncode()
ids=list(map(int,p.stdout.split()))
assert ids==json.loads((old/'hf-generated.json').read_text()), 'greedy mismatch'
count=0
maximum=0.0
squared=0.0
for suffix in ['-logits.f32']+[f'-step-{i:02d}.f32' for i in range(32)]:
    a=(out/('llmx'+suffix)).read_bytes(); b=(old/('hf'+suffix)).read_bytes()
    assert len(a)==len(b)==151936*4
    for (x,), (y,) in zip(struct.iter_unpack('<f',a),struct.iter_unpack('<f',b)):
        assert math.isfinite(x) and math.isfinite(y)
        delta=abs(x-y)
        maximum=max(maximum,delta); squared+=delta*delta; count+=1
assert maximum<=0.001, maximum
result=dict(prompt_tokens=1943,generated_tokens=len(ids),greedy_match=True,logits_compared=count,max_abs_error=maximum,rms_error=math.sqrt(squared/count),bound=0.001)
(out/'comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)

out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)

rows=[]
for pair in range(8):
    order=list(arms)
    order=order[pair%len(arms):]+order[:pair%len(arms)]

        (out/f'{pair}-{arm}.stdout').write_bytes(p.stdout)

        assert arm=='mx' or row['logit_sum']==-501040.0615

        (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
        print(row,flush=True)
summary={}
for arm in arms:
    summary[arm]={}
    for phase in ('pp','tg'):
        rates=[r[phase+'_tokens']*1000/r[phase+'_ms'] for r in rows if r['arm']==arm]
        summary[arm][phase]=dict(mean=statistics.mean(rates),median=statistics.median(rates),minimum=min(rates),maximum=max(rates))
(out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
print(summary,flush=True)

import hashlib,json,statistics,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).parent
out=root/'small-guard'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
rows=[]
for pair in range(4):
    for arm in (('before','after') if pair%2==0 else ('after','before')):
        p=subprocess.run([str(root/f'small-{arm}.exe')],capture_output=True,timeout=120)
        (out/f'{pair}-{arm}.stdout').write_bytes(p.stdout)
        (out/f'{pair}-{arm}.stderr').write_bytes(p.stderr)
        p.check_returncode()
        values=[json.loads(line) for line in p.stdout.splitlines()]
        assert len(values)==12
        rows.extend(dict(pair=pair,arm=arm,**v) for v in values)
        (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
        print(pair,arm,flush=True)
summary=[]
for nt in (1,6):
    for b in (1,2,4,8,16,64):
        selected=[v for v in rows if v['threads']==nt and v['batch']==b]
        assert len(set(v['sum'] for v in selected))==1
        item=dict(threads=nt,batch=b)
        for arm in ('before','after'):
            values=[v['ms'] for v in selected if v['arm']==arm]
            item[arm]=dict(mean_ms=statistics.mean(values),median_ms=statistics.median(values),min_ms=min(values),max_ms=max(values))
        summary.append(item)
(out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
(out/'hashes.json').write_text(json.dumps({a:hashlib.file_digest((root/f'small-{a}.exe').open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest() for a in ('before','after')},indent=2))
print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2),flush=True)
